{{Quote|Alluvial dampers regulate the flow of ion particles into the hyperdrive to help keep it from overheating.|Malavai Quinn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''alluvial damper''' was a subsystem of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that was responsible for the regulation of thrust output from the generator. It operated by moving a [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotor]]-controlled plate to channel the emission of ion particles from the hyperdrive in a certain direction.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once resisted a temptation to convert [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] into a pair of backup alluvial dampers.<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>
